readme.run: Align a follow-up dermoscopy image to baseline and map CIEDE2000 change
notes: Inputs are two JPEG or PNG dermoscopy photographs: BASELINE first, FOLLOWUP second.
Pass --allow-scale for similarity scaling (0.85 to 1.15) in addition to rigid rotation/shift.
Pass --max-angle N (0 to 90, default 25) to adjust the coarse rotation search span.
No network connection is required and no external model weights are downloaded.
Interactive flicker and curtain inspection are available in the DermCompare web app.
